english_source_note: Integrating via Binary Expansion of the Variable
callout_id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#7
english_title: Lebesgue Measure of the Cantor Set
statement_en: Define the Cantor set \\(C\\) as the subset of \\([0,1]\\) consisting of those real numbers whose ternary expansions do not contain the digit 1. If \\(m\\) denotes Lebesgue measure on \\(\\mathbb R\\), then $$m(C)=0.$$
callout_body: 定义Cantor集合$C$为闭区间$[0,1]$的一个子集，其元素由那些三进制表示中不包含数字1的$[0,1]$中的实数构成。$m$是实数上的Lebesgue测度，那么$$m(C)=0$$
